issue.title: highlights create --audio lacks a shell-completion kinds decision, failing every_value_arg_has_a_decision
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision` (src/native/completion/kinds.rs)

`cargo test --lib` fails deterministically on master fbc4f43 (and on fbc4f43^, verified by bob-cli-4i.1/.2/.3/.4 via git stash) with:

    value-taking args without a kinds decision: ["highlights create:audio"]

Root cause: commit 2152202 (feat(highlights): discover sase-listen companion audio at create time, landed by sase-1g6.land) added `Arg::new("audio").long("audio")` to `bob highlights create` (src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs:202) without a completion-kind decision. The coverage test requires every value-taking arg to have a kinds table entry, possible values, or a non-trivial clap ValueHint.

Fix: give `--audio` a `ValueHint::FilePath` (it takes an audio file path) or add a `highlights create`/`audio` file-path entry to the kinds table in src/native/completion/kinds.rs, then confirm `bob highlights create --audio <TAB>` completes files. `cargo test --lib` should then pass.

Proposed as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by bob-cli-4i.1 (note #2), bob-cli-4i.2 (note #1), bob-cli-4i.3 (note #1), and bob-cli-4i.4 (note #1); filed by the bob-cli-4i land agent.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every run, serial or parallel, with the same deterministic message naming 'highlights create:audio'; reproduced on fbc4f43^ and fbc4f43.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-4i's phases all reported this lib test failure as pre-existing; it makes cargo test red on master and was caused by the sase-1g6 highlights audio landing, not by bob-cli-4i.

evidence.note: Independent bob-cli-4i.7 landing run on db1da70: cargo test exits 101 solely because native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision names highlights create:audio. 1716 lib tests passed; a separate cargo test --test cli run passed all 1000 tests. Same proposals from bob-cli-4i.1 #2/.2 #1/.3 #1/.4 #1; no duplicate task.

Proposed by bob-cli-4q.4 note #2; independently reproduced during bob-cli-4q landing on ade4b8a: exact serial cargo test --lib native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision fails with highlights create:audio. The inbox-routing epic changes only docs and linked plugins, so this is the existing pre-epic completion coverage defect.

Proposed by bob-cli-4s.1 #2, .2 #2, .3 #1, .4 #1, .5 #1. Independently reproduced by bob-cli-4s.land: just all on master fe1c05f fails every_value_arg_has_a_decision with exactly ["highlights create:audio"]. The new create args from bob-cli-4s (-N/--name, -T/--title, the target positional) all have kinds decisions, so --audio is still the only gap.

Proposed by bob-cli-4w.1 #1, .2 #2, .3 #3, .4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #1, .8 #2, .9 #1, .11 #7 (now surfaces as ref create:audio after the bob ref rename). Independently reproduced by bob-cli-4w.land on master e3e69df: just all lib run fails native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision at src/native/completion/kinds.rs:522, and an isolated --exact rerun fails identically (deterministic).

Proposed by bob-cli-55.1 note #2; independent landing reproduction on master 092e098: cargo test --lib native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision -- --exact exits 101 and names exactly ref create:audio. Neither completion/kinds.rs nor highlights_ref/create.rs changed in bob-cli-55. This is the existing missing --audio completion decision after the ref rename, so no duplicate task.

Proposed by bob-cli-52.1 #1, .2 #1, .3 #1, .4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #1, .7 #1, .9 #10. Independently reproduced by bob-cli-52.land: just all on master 2d568fa fails native::completion::kinds::tests::every_value_arg_has_a_decision with exactly ["ref create:audio"]. No bob-cli-52 commit touches completion/kinds.rs or the --audio arg.

payload.entry: Fixed on athena atop 6244ddd (uncommitted working tree): added .value_hint(FilePath) to the audio arg in src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs; kinds coverage test passes; new protocol assertion proves bob __complete zsh --protocol 1 -- bob ref create --audio '' emits !files. Pandoc n/a.
